definitions.name: G0C.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.MEAN
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.DEVIATIONS
definitions.note: Vector of each element minus the mean

definitions.name: G0C.VARIANCE
definitions.note: population variance as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.STDDEV
definitions.note: population standard deviation (exact SQRT) as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.MIN
definitions.body: 'G0C.L' BIND G0C.L G0C.L 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.MAX
definitions.body: 'G0C.H' BIND G0C.H G0C.H 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.RANGE
definitions.note: max minus min as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G0C.N' BIND G0C.N G0C.N G0C.MIN - G0C.N G0C.RANGE /

definitions.name: G0C.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: G0C.UNWORDS
definitions.note: join a Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: G0C.CAPITALIZE
definitions.body: CHARS 'G0C.C' BIND G0C.C [ 1 ] TAKE JOIN UPPER G0C.C [ 1 ] DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first character of a String

definitions.name: G0C.TITLECASE
definitions.note: capitalize every word of a space-separated String

definitions.name: G0C.WORD-LENGTHS
definitions.note: Vector of character counts of each word

definitions.name: G0C.LONGEST
definitions.note: length of the longest word as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0C.LONG-WORDS
definitions.note: words longer than 3 characters, in order

definitions.name: G0C.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0C.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word as one String
